grassiergrass.configuration.bladesPerBlo: Number of grass blades rendered on each grass block.
grassiergrass.configuration.grassSparsit: Removes blades from the randomized outer rims of grass clumps inward. 0.00 keeps all blades; 1.00 removes all blades.
grassiergrass.configuration.heightVariat: Scales how much blade height varies. 1.00x is the default look; 0 makes every blade the same height; 5.00x is the maximum.
grassiergrass.configuration.renderRadius: How far (in blocks) grass renders around you.
grassiergrass.configuration.dynamicWindS: Limits the full dynamic-wind speed range. 1.00x preserves the current wind; 0.00x is completely calm.
grassiergrass.configuration.grassStyle.t: Blade look: Tapered (smooth gradient) or Segmented (vanilla-like).
grassiergrass.configuration.grassPlantsA: Converts vanilla short and tall grass into generated blades. When disabled, their original models sway like other plants.
grassiergrass.configuration.denseFlowers: Flowers surrounded by more flowers sprout extra companions, filling out patches.
grassiergrass.configuration.bladeParticl: Sheds occasional grass-blade particles into sufficiently strong wind.
grassiergrass.configuration.grassThrough: Renders grass blades when a snow layer covers the grass block.
grassiergrass.configuration.shaderPackSh: Lets grass blades and re-rendered plants cast Iris/Oculus shader-pack shadows. This may reduce performance.
grassiergrass.configuration.grassBrightn: Brightness multiplier for the grass colour.
grassiergrass.configuration.bladeHueJitt: Maximum stable hue difference between individual blades. 9 degrees is the default; 0 disables per-blade jitter.
grassiergrass.configuration.bladeGradien: Brightness multiplier at the base of each grass blade.
Brightness multiplier at the tip of each grass blade.
Blade gradient response curve. 1.0 is linear.
grassiergrass.configuration.plantBlackli: Block ids Grassier Grass leaves to vanilla rendering.
grassiergrass.configuration.plantWhiteli: Extra block ids Grassier Grass hides and re-renders as grass blades.
